metadata.name: Marketplace Seller Fee Reduction Test
metadata.description: Tests a 15% fee reduction to increase gross merchandise value. Established sellers benefit immediately; new sellers are overwhelmed by the change and show a slight GMV decline.
metadata.what_is_interesting: Days 8-9 have a 5x volume spike that triggers IsolationForest and the volume-spike anomaly check. HTE splits sharply on seller tenure: established sellers (+12% GMV) vs new sellers (-5% GMV).

key_insights: Data quality issues detected (outlier_days, volume_spike). Validity: WARNING.
Effect is stable. Safe to make shipping decision.

Strongest treatment modifier: seller_tenure_days (ATE=+16.5927, stability=0.94). Target top 20% of users by predicted lift (ITE ≥ 60.250); expected lift for this segment: +195.599 driven by seller_tenure_days_x_treat. Overall ATE: +16.593.
ml_result.recommendation: Results need review. Check flagged issues before acting.

hte.business_recommendation: Target top 20% of users by predicted lift (ITE ≥ 60.250); expected lift for this segment: +195.599 driven by seller_tenure_days_x_treat. Overall ATE: +16.593.

segments.overall_recommendation: Roll out to segment 0. Investigate segment 1 (inconclusive). Overall ATE: +16.593.

segments.description: Segment 0: mid-sized group (31% of users) with seller_tenure_days above average (314.57 vs 148.17). Lift: +90.266 (significant).
Segment 1: large group (69% of users) with seller_tenure_days below average (74.63 vs 148.17). Lift: -16.361 (not significant).

anomaly.recommendation: Proceed with caution. Review flagged issues before acting on results.
